events.content:
Migration complete. Here's a summary of what changed:

**Files created:**
- `app/layout.tsx` — replaces `pages/_app.tsx` + `pages/_document.tsx`. Contains the `<html>` and `<body>` shell and exports shared `Metadata` with a title template.
- `app/page.tsx` — replaces `pages/index.tsx`. Exports per-page `metadata` instead of using `<Head>`. Uses `<Link>` from `next/link`.
- `app/about/page.tsx` — replaces `pages/about.tsx`. Same pattern.

**Files deleted:**
- `pages/_app.tsx`, `pages/_document.tsx`, `pages/index.tsx`, `pages/about.tsx` (and the `pages/` directory itself).

**Key pattern changes:**
| Pages Router | App Router |
|---|---|
| `next/head` `<Head>` component | `export const metadata: Metadata` |
| `pages/_app.tsx` wrapping component | `app/layout.tsx` root layout |
| `pages/_document.tsx` HTML shell | `app/layout.tsx` `<html>/<body>` tags |
| `pages/index.tsx` | `app/page.tsx` |
| `pages/about.tsx` | `app/about/page.tsx` |
| Bare `<a>` tags | `<Link>` from `next/link` |

Both routes (`/` and `/about`) are now statically prerendered under the App Router.
